title: Regulation (EC) No 883/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 29 April 2004 on the coordination of social security systems
provider: Publications Office of the European Union (CELLAR repository behind EUR-Lex)
access_route: CELLAR content negotiation (Accept: application/xhtml+xml, Accept-Language: eng); work URI found by SPARQL at https://publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql. eur-lex.europa.eu itself answered with an AWS WAF bot challenge (HTTP 202, x-amzn-waf-action: challenge) and was not used.
version_kind: EUR-Lex consolidation date (date of the last amendment incorporated)
converter: eu_convert.py (legalese commons, 2026-10-20): EUR-Lex XHTML (consolidated and OJ formats) to plain text; headings and Article numbers kept, points as '(a) text', tables as '| a | b |' rows with spanned cells left empty, consolidation markers removed except in the 'Amended by' table, deleted provisions as '[deleted]'
text_caveat: Not authentic. Complex tables with row and column spans are flattened and may misalign; check any table against the OJ before encoding from it. Footnotes are kept where they fall in the XHTML.
role_in_set: The core coordination rules: who is covered (Arts 2-3), equal treatment and aggregation of periods (Arts 4-6), waiving of residence rules (Art 7), which single State's legislation applies (Title II, Arts 11-16, incl. posting Art 12), and the special chapters for sickness, invalidity, old-age and survivors' pensions (pro rata calculation), accidents at work, death grants, unemployment (Arts 61-65a, export for 3-6 months under Art 64), pre-retirement and family benefits (Arts 67-69), and special non-contributory cash benefits (Art 70, Annex X).
set: eu cross-border social security, benefits and personal income tax sample, 2026-10-20 (see subjects/eu/README.md)
